entries.title: Rain days redone: one row per series, wet in rain blue over dry in grey, an arrow from his typical dry race to his typical wet one

values.label: rows (default): each series its own ruled row, wet races in a light rain lane over dry races, arrow dry → wet; worse ← → better written across the top
bands: the dry races become his usual range (the middle half, a grey band) with the wet races falling onto it; dry races as a quiet rug beneath
round 2: all 167 dots in every series colour, All races / By series toggle

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → Rain days. Watch the races fall into their rows, then the arrows draw: All 167 races points right (82% wet vs 63% dry), Formula Ford and GB3 point left. Point at any dot: it is ringed, a guide runs up to the scale, and the card shows the track still, the finish and the weather in the site's words with its source ("damp track (series report)", "dry track (modelled, Open-Meteo)"). A solid dot is a reported or observed call, a light one modelled.

entries.title: The explorer's dots redone: same motion, the site's flat dot in soft ink on an even lattice; a series takes its hue only when pointed at or followed

values.label: ink (default): flat soft-ink dots at rest; point at a dot or a series name (or follow one) and that series lights in its hue while the rest step back; wins gold with an amber ring
beads: each dot a small bead in its series colour, lit from the top left, soft shadow
flat: flat dots in every series colour at once, a little quieter
round 2: the free beeswarm with flat full-colour dots

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → The explorer. At rest every race is a soft-ink dot. Point at any dot (or a series name in the Series view) and its series lights in its own colour; click a name to follow it and it stays lit. Flip Series / Season / Track / Weather: the dots travel as before. ?ddxdots=beads, flat and old to compare.
